integrity: Every connected unlabeled graph through six vertices in the embedded Graph Atlas table is checked. Betweenness is reconstructed by two independent exact rational algorithms; eigenvector coordinate ordering is certified by integer characteristic polynomials, rational Sturm isolation of the Perron root, and principal cofactors; automorphism groups and labeled orbit totals are replayed directly.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns connected finite simple undirected unweighted graphs, ordinary Freeman shortest-path betweenness, ordinary adjacency eigenvector centrality, and only cases in which both maximizing sets are singletons. The exact census stops at six vertices.
title: Six vertices are the sharp unique-leader split for betweenness and eigenvector centrality
